about: Reference pack for the frigate Commonwealth (invented; based on the Humphreys 44-gun frigates). All drawings are US National Archives records on Wikimedia Commons, public domain: free to use commercially, nothing to credit (we credit NARA anyway). Files are not committed: Tools/shipkit/fetch_refs.py downloads them to git-ignored Data/Reference/raw/ships/Commonwealth/. Measured, never imported.
